title: BETA-Labeling for Multilingual Dataset Construction in Low-Resource IR

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring language-pair-dependent (LPD) bias by evaluating translation quality and implicit meaning preservation (using BLEU, METEOR, BERTScore, Cosine Similarity, and Jaccard Similarity) across different source-target language directions to identify structural and linguistic asymmetries.

Evaluating semantic drift and the loss of implicit intent when translating culturally grounded data (e.g., historical and regional traditions) across linguistically and culturally distant language pairs.
